reference_action: Kalanchoe remains limp despite resumed watering; OP confirms one-hour pot soak made leaves firmer. Flower removal in summary is not the confirmed action.

sources.reason: Water-when-dry, light/pruning/repot alternatives omit thorough soak despite existing routine failing.
Owner in retrieved thread explicitly gave good soak and reports firmer leaves; directly actionable matching result.
Bloom-trigger darkness and dry intervals; no soaking remedy.
Wilting FAQ says if too dry water deeply; partial deep-rehydration match, not timed hour soak.
Care list explicitly water deeply after mostly drying; partial thorough-watering match.

actions.action: Provide bright light with some direct sun

resolved.reason: Correct plant but general care repeats existing watering rather than rehydrating soil fully. Repot/division alternatives distract from confirmed easy remedy.

harmfulness.reason: “Repot into large pot…or split” is unnecessary before checking water absorption. Routine fertilizing lacks dose guidance, though watering only when dry is sensible.

specificity_accuracy.reason: Kalanchoe care is relevant, including soft leaves and light. It does not explain why a month of resumed watering has failed.

feasibility.reason: Basic light and watering are easy. Several pruning, propagation and repotting alternatives leave the owner with many tasks and no clear priority.
